guideContent.strategyOverview: Jund artifact token engine that creates Treasures, Food, Blood, Clues, Mutagens, and Munitions, then sacrifices them to drain opponents' life totals. Korvold draws a card and grows whenever you sacrifice a permanent — including the tokens he forces you to sacrifice on attack. Mirkwood Bats is the #1 payoff, dealing 1 life to each opponent on BOTH token creation AND sacrifice (double drain per lifecycle). Academy Manufactor triples Clue/Food/Treasure creation, and Chatterfang doubles all tokens with bonus Squirrels. The deck wins through accumulated drain damage from multiple payoffs, Marionette Master one-shots (fabricate 3 → sac 5 Treasures = 20 damage), or one of 9 infinite combo lines — including a 2-card engine (Chatterfang + Pitiless Plunderer), 4 self-killing infinites, and the improved Skeleton loop (life-neutral with Phyrexian Altar).

winConditions.title: Drain Stack
winConditions.description: Assemble multiple drain payoffs on the board. Each artifact token creation triggers ETB pingers (Fireweaver, Artillerist) and Mirkwood Bats. Each sacrifice triggers Bats again, plus Disciple of the Vault, Mayhem Devil, and any other payoffs. With 3-4 payoffs in play, each artifact lifecycle deals 4-8 damage per opponent.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Primary win condition via accumulated drain

winConditions.title: Marionette Master Bomb
winConditions.description: Cast Marionette Master choosing Fabricate 3 for a 4/6 body. Then sacrifice 5 Treasures — each one deals 4 damage to an opponent (power = 4). That's 20 damage to one player, lethal from starting life. Tokens go to graveyard before ceasing to exist (CR 111.7), triggering Master's ability.

winConditions.title: Infinite Drain Combo
winConditions.description: Sacrifice Reassembling Skeleton to Warren Soultrader (creates Treasure). Pitiless Plunderer triggers (creates another Treasure). Pay {1}{B} from the 2 Treasures to return Skeleton from graveyard. Repeat infinitely. Each loop creates and sacrifices 2 Treasures — with any drain payoff (Mirkwood Bats, Disciple, etc.), this deals infinite damage. All three combo pieces are independently strong in the deck.

winConditions.title: Revel in Riches
winConditions.description: Revel in Riches wins the game at your upkeep if you control 10+ Treasures. Blood Money destroys all creatures and creates a Treasure per nontoken killed — in a 4-player game, this can produce 10+ Treasures in one shot. Revel also generates Treasures passively whenever opponents' creatures die.

winConditions.title: Korvold Commander Damage
winConditions.description: Korvold grows +1/+1 per sacrifice and has flying. In a deck that sacrifices 3-5 permanents per turn cycle, Korvold quickly reaches 10+ power. With Lightning Greaves for haste and protection, a 15/15 flying Korvold can eliminate a player in 2-3 combat steps.

sources.name: The Commander's Quarters — Korvold Budget
sources.detail: Korvold voltron as backup win condition

winConditions.title: Chatterfang + Plunderer Engine
winConditions.description: 2-card infinite engine. Start with 1 Squirrel + {B}. Activate Chatterfang ({B}: target creature gets +1/-1) to kill the Squirrel. Pitiless Plunderer creates a Treasure. Chatterfang's replacement effect creates a bonus Squirrel alongside the Treasure. Sacrifice the Treasure for {B}. Repeat infinitely — produces infinite creature deaths, infinite Treasure creation/sacrifice, and kills all opponent creatures via +1/-1. Needs a drain payoff (13 in deck) or Korvold to convert into a win.

winConditions.title: Soultrader + Egotist + Chatterfang Drain
winConditions.description: Self-killing 3-card infinite. Sacrifice a creature to Soultrader (-1 life, creates Treasure). Popular Egotist triggers on the permanent sacrifice (opponent loses 1, you gain 1 — net life: 0). Chatterfang creates a Squirrel alongside the Treasure. Sacrifice the Treasure for {B} and repeat with the new Squirrel. Egotist's drain IS the win condition — no extra payoff needed.

winConditions.title: Soultrader + Manufactor + Chatterfang
winConditions.description: 3-card infinite with life management. Sacrifice a Squirrel to Soultrader (-1 life, Treasure). Manufactor replaces Treasure with Treasure + Food + Clue. Chatterfang creates 3 bonus Squirrels. Net: +2 Squirrels, +1 of each token type per loop. Batch every 2 loops: crack 1 Food (gain 3 life, spend {2} from Treasures) to offset the 2 life lost. Net: +1 life per 2 loops. Truly infinite when batched.

winConditions.title: Mahadi + Revel in Riches + Viscera Seer
winConditions.description: Conditional game win. At end step, Mahadi triggers to create Treasures equal to creatures that died this turn. Hold priority and sacrifice creatures to Viscera Seer. Mahadi counts deaths at resolution (not trigger time). With 10+ creatures dying, Mahadi creates 10+ Treasures — Revel in Riches wins at your next upkeep.

winConditions.title: Crime Novelist + Animation Module + Bombardment
winConditions.description: Self-killing 3-card infinite. Sacrifice a Servo token to Goblin Bombardment (1 damage to opponent). Crime Novelist triggers on artifact sacrifice (+1/+1 counter + {R}). Animation Module triggers on the +1/+1 counter (pay {1} to create a Servo). Spend the {R} as {1} for Module. Repeat infinitely for infinite damage.

winConditions.title: Cauldron Familiar + Soultrader + Manufactor
winConditions.description: Self-killing 3-card infinite. Sacrifice Cauldron Familiar to Soultrader (-1 life, Treasure). Manufactor triples the Treasure into Treasure + Food + Clue. Cat's graveyard ability: sacrifice the Food (free — Cat's own ability, not Food's {2} activated ability) to return Cat to the battlefield. Cat ETB drains each opponent 1 life and you gain 1 (net life: 0). Repeat infinitely for infinite drain.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Combo identification; Cat's Food sac verified as free (distinct from Food's {2},{T} ability)

winConditions.title: Forsaken Miner + Plunderer + Bombardment
winConditions.description: Self-killing 3-card infinite. Sacrifice Forsaken Miner to Goblin Bombardment targeting an opponent (1 damage). Targeting an opponent is a crime — Miner's ability triggers. Plunderer creates a Treasure (Miner died). Pay {B} from the Treasure to return Miner to the battlefield. Repeat infinitely for infinite damage. Stack ordering: target (crime) is declared before cost (sacrifice), so Miner is in graveyard when its crime trigger resolves.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Combo identification; CR 602.2 stack ordering verified

winConditions.title: Plunderer + Phyrexian Altar + Skeleton
winConditions.description: Life-neutral variant of the Skeleton combo. Sacrifice Skeleton to Phyrexian Altar (add {B}, 0 life cost). Plunderer creates a Treasure. Pay {1} from Treasure + {B} from Altar to return Skeleton. Repeat infinitely. Unlike the Soultrader version, this costs 0 life per loop. Add any drain payoff to win.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Improved variant of existing Skeleton combo; Phyrexian Altar provides free colored mana

synergies.title: Triple Token Engine
synergies.description: Academy Manufactor converts any Clue, Food, or Treasure creation into all three types. Each original token becomes 3 tokens, triggering Mirkwood Bats 3 times on creation. When all 3 are sacrificed, Bats triggers 3 more times. Net: 6 life loss per opponent per original token instead of 2.

synergies.title: Squirrel Token Doubler
synergies.description: Chatterfang creates a bonus Squirrel token alongside every other token you create. Each Treasure creation becomes Treasure + Squirrel — doubling Mirkwood Bats triggers. Chatterfang's built-in sac outlet ({B}, sac X Squirrels) provides removal while triggering more drain.

synergies.title: Korvold Fetch Value
synergies.description: Each fetchland sacrifice triggers Korvold — draw a card + put a +1/+1 counter on him. With 3 fetches in the deck, each one becomes a land drop + cantrip + Korvold pump. Sakura-Tribe Elder does the same while also fixing mana.

synergies.title: Manufactor + Chatterfang Explosion
synergies.description: With both in play, creating a single Treasure becomes: Clue + Food + Treasure (Manufactor) + 3 Squirrels (Chatterfang sees 3 tokens created). That's 6 tokens from 1 trigger. Add Parallel Lives and it becomes 12.

synergies.title: Artifact Removal Synergy
synergies.description: Grim Bauble is a 1-mana artifact that gives -2/-2 on ETB and sacs itself for surveil 2. As a nontoken artifact, it triggers Weapons Manufacturing (creates a Munitions token worth 2 damage). The Bauble's death triggers Disciple of the Vault and other artifact death payoffs. Tithing Blade works similarly.

synergies.title: Crime Novelist Mana Engine
synergies.description: Crime Novelist gets a +1/+1 counter and adds {R} whenever you sacrifice an artifact. With Treasures flowing from Pitiless Plunderer and other generators, each Treasure sac grows the Novelist and produces red mana to cast more spells. Novelist quickly becomes a massive threat while fueling the turn.

synergies.title: Mutagen Cost Reduction
synergies.description: Mutagen Man reduces artifact token activation costs by {1}. Blood tokens normally cost {1} to crack — with Mutagen Man, they're free. Clues and Food drop from {2} to {1}. This turns every artifact token into a cheaper sacrifice trigger for Biotech Specialist's 2-damage ability and all drain payoffs.

synergies.title: Obsessive Token Factory
synergies.description: Obsessive Pursuit creates a Clue token each upkeep (free artifact for sacrifice). When Korvold attacks and forces a sacrifice, sac the Clue — triggers Korvold's draw + counter, plus all drain payoffs. The enchantment's second ability puts +1/+1 counters on attacking creatures and grants lifelink when you sacrifice nontoken permanents.

synergies.title: Infinite Treasure Loop
synergies.description: Sac Skeleton to Soultrader (creates Treasure, pay 1 life). Plunderer triggers (creates Treasure). Sac both Treasures for {1}{B} to return Skeleton. Repeat infinitely. Net each loop: infinite Treasure creation + sacrifice, infinite life loss (1 per loop), infinite Korvold triggers if he's in play. Add any drain payoff to win.

synergies.title: Animation Module + Crime Novelist
synergies.description: Crime Novelist gets a +1/+1 counter whenever you sacrifice an artifact. Animation Module triggers on the counter, letting you pay {1} to create a Servo token. The Novelist also adds {R} on artifact sacrifice, which pays for Module. With any free sac outlet (Goblin Bombardment, Viscera Seer), this generates infinite tokens or goes infinite.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Synergy identification; Animation Module enables Servo generation from Novelist triggers

synergies.title: Cauldron Familiar + Food Chain
synergies.description: Cauldron Familiar returns from the graveyard by sacrificing a Food token (free). Gilded Goose, Academy Manufactor, and Tireless Provisioner all generate Food. Each Cat ETB drains each opponent 1 life. With any sac outlet, the Cat becomes a repeatable drain engine fueled by Food generation.

synergies.title: Forsaken Miner + Crime Triggers
synergies.description: Forsaken Miner returns from the graveyard for {B} whenever you commit a crime (target opponents or their stuff). Goblin Bombardment, Mayhem Devil, Chaos Warp, Beast Within, Assassin's Trophy, and Reanimate (targeting opponent's graveyard) all commit crimes. The Miner becomes a recursive sacrifice fodder engine for Korvold and drain payoffs.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Crime mechanic synergy with existing sac outlets and removal

synergies.title: Phyrexian Altar + Skeleton (Life-Neutral)
synergies.description: Phyrexian Altar sacrifices a creature for one mana of any color — no life cost unlike Warren Soultrader. With Pitiless Plunderer, this makes the Skeleton loop life-neutral (0 per loop instead of -1). Also enables sacrifice of any creature for colored mana, fueling Korvold triggers and drain payoffs without life pressure.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Upgrade to Skeleton combo line; premium free sac outlet

synergies.title: Reanimate as Crime + Recursion
synergies.description: Reanimate targeting an opponent's graveyard is a crime, triggering Forsaken Miner's return. At {B}, it's the most efficient recursion in the deck — returns Mirkwood Bats (4 life), Pitiless Plunderer (4 life), or Chatterfang (3 life) after removal. Can also steal an opponent's best creature.

synergies.title: Forsaken Miner + Plunderer + Bombardment
synergies.description: Self-killing 3-card infinite damage loop. Sacrifice Forsaken Miner to Goblin Bombardment targeting an opponent (1 damage, commits a crime). Pitiless Plunderer creates a Treasure on Miner's death. Miner's crime trigger returns it from the graveyard for {B} (paid from the Treasure). Repeat for infinite damage.

synergies.title: Crime Novelist + Animation Module + Bombardment
synergies.description: Self-killing 3-card infinite damage loop. Sacrifice a Servo to Goblin Bombardment (1 damage). Crime Novelist triggers on artifact sacrifice: add {R} and put a +1/+1 counter on itself. Animation Module triggers on the counter: pay {1} (funded by {R}) to create a new Servo. Repeat for infinite damage.

synergies.title: Mahadi + Revel in Riches + Phyrexian Altar
synergies.description: Infinite mana and death triggers. Sacrifice a creature to Phyrexian Altar for mana. Mahadi triggers at end step creating Treasures equal to creatures that died. Revel in Riches converts those Treasures into additional mana fodder. With enough death triggers, generates unbounded mana and positions Revel to win on upkeep.

synergies.title: Cauldron Familiar + Manufactor + Plunderer + Altar
synergies.description: Infinite death triggers, mana, and tokens. Sacrifice Cauldron Familiar to Phyrexian Altar for mana. Plunderer creates a Treasure. Manufactor triples the Treasure into Treasure + Food + Clue. Cat returns from the graveyard by sacrificing the Food (free). Each loop creates additional Clues and Treasures for unbounded value.

synergies.title: Cauldron Familiar + Manufactor + Plunderer + Viscera Seer
synergies.description: Infinite scry, death triggers, and drain. Sacrifice Cauldron Familiar to Viscera Seer (scry 1). Plunderer creates a Treasure. Manufactor triples it into Treasure + Food + Clue. Cat returns by sacrificing the Food. Each loop scries and drains each opponent 1 life via the Cat's ETB.

synergies.title: Soultrader + Forsaken Miner + Popular Egotist
synergies.description: Self-killing 3-card infinite drain. Sacrifice Forsaken Miner to Soultrader (pay 1 life, create Treasure). Popular Egotist triggers on the permanent sacrifice (opponent loses 1, you gain 1 — net 0 life). Sacrifice the Treasure for {B} to commit a crime, returning Miner. Repeat for infinite life drain at zero net life loss.

synergies.title: Cauldron Familiar + Manufactor + Plunderer + Umbral Collar Zealot
synergies.description: Infinite death triggers and tokens. Sacrifice Cauldron Familiar to Umbral Collar Zealot. Plunderer creates a Treasure. Manufactor triples it into Treasure + Food + Clue. Cat returns by sacrificing the Food. Each loop produces net Clues and Treasures for infinite value.

synergies.title: Korvold + Animation Module + Plunderer + Viscera Seer
synergies.description: Infinite draw, +1/+1 counters, and scry. Sacrifice a creature to Viscera Seer (scry 1). Plunderer creates a Treasure. Korvold draws a card and gets a counter. Animation Module triggers on the counter: pay {1} (from Treasure) to create a Servo. Sacrifice the Servo to repeat — infinite draw and infinite Korvold growth.

synergies.title: Korvold + Animation Module + Phyrexian Altar
synergies.description: Infinite draw, +1/+1 counters, and mana. Sacrifice a creature to Phyrexian Altar for mana. Korvold draws and gets a counter. Animation Module triggers on the counter: pay {1} to create a Servo. Sacrifice the Servo for more mana and repeat. Generates unbounded mana, cards, and a lethal Korvold.

synergies.title: Animation Module + Plunderer + Umbral Collar Zealot
synergies.description: Infinite death triggers and tokens. Sacrifice a token to Umbral Collar Zealot. Plunderer creates a Treasure. Animation Module triggers on any +1/+1 counter placed (e.g., via Korvold or other counter source): pay {1} from Treasure to create a Servo. Sacrifice the Servo to repeat for infinite value.

synergies.title: Forsaken Miner + Phyrexian Altar + Popular Egotist
synergies.description: Infinite death triggers and mana. Sacrifice Forsaken Miner to Phyrexian Altar for {B}. Popular Egotist triggers on the sacrifice (opponent loses 1, you gain 1). Spend {B} to return Miner from the graveyard (crime not required — the Altar sac returns Miner via Popular Egotist's trigger enabling the loop). Repeat for infinite mana and drain.

synergies.title: Korvold + Animation Module + Plunderer + Bombardment
synergies.description: Infinite damage, draw, and +1/+1 counters. Sacrifice a creature to Goblin Bombardment (1 damage). Plunderer creates a Treasure. Korvold draws and gets a counter. Animation Module triggers on the counter: pay {1} from Treasure to create a Servo. Sacrifice the Servo to Bombardment and repeat for infinite damage and Korvold growth.

synergies.title: Cauldron Familiar + Manufactor + Plunderer + Bombardment
synergies.description: Infinite damage, death triggers, and tokens. Sacrifice Cauldron Familiar to Goblin Bombardment (1 damage). Plunderer creates a Treasure. Manufactor triples it into Treasure + Food + Clue. Cat returns by sacrificing the Food. Each loop deals 1 damage and produces net Clue tokens for unbounded damage.

synergies.title: Animation Module + Phyrexian Altar + Ravenous Squirrel
synergies.description: Infinite death triggers, +1/+1 counters, and mana. Sacrifice a token to Phyrexian Altar for mana. Ravenous Squirrel gets a +1/+1 counter when a token dies. Animation Module triggers on the counter: pay {1} to create a Servo. Sacrifice the Servo to repeat. Generates infinite mana, infinite counters on Squirrel, and infinite death triggers.

synergies.title: Korvold + Animation Module + Plunderer + Umbral Collar Zealot
synergies.description: Infinite draw, +1/+1 counters, and death triggers. Sacrifice a creature to Umbral Collar Zealot. Plunderer creates a Treasure. Korvold draws and gets a counter. Animation Module triggers on the counter: pay {1} from Treasure to create a Servo. Sacrifice the Servo to repeat — infinite draw and a lethal Korvold.

highlights.name: Mirkwood Bats
highlights.reason: The deck's #1 payoff. Triggers on BOTH token creation AND sacrifice — each artifact token lifecycle drains 2 life per opponent. With Academy Manufactor tripling tokens, a single Treasure creation deals 6 life.

highlights.name: Academy Manufactor
highlights.reason: Triples every Clue, Food, or Treasure creation into one of each type. Exponentially multiplies all drain triggers and creates massive board presence from single token generators.

highlights.name: Pitiless Plunderer
highlights.reason: Creates a Treasure whenever another creature dies. Essential combo piece with Warren Soultrader + Reassembling Skeleton for infinite drain. Also provides enormous value during board wipes.

highlights.name: Chatterfang, Squirrel General
highlights.reason: Doubles token output by creating a bonus Squirrel alongside every token. Built-in sacrifice outlet removes threats while triggering drain payoffs. Combined with Manufactor, a single token becomes 6.

highlights.name: Marionette Master
highlights.reason: One-shot finisher. Choose Fabricate 3 for a 4/6 body, then sacrifice 5 Treasures to deal 20 damage to one opponent. The premier burst damage card in any artifact sacrifice strategy.

highlights.name: Necropotence
highlights.reason: Pay life to draw cards at end step. Finds combo pieces in 1-2 activations. Skips draw step but Korvold's sacrifice trigger still draws. Three tutors fetch it directly. Strictly dominates Sylvan Library's card selection role.

highlights.name: Demonic Tutor
highlights.reason: Finds any card in the deck for {1}{B}. Grab Mirkwood Bats to start the drain engine, Academy Manufactor to triple tokens, or a combo piece to close the game. The most efficient tutor in Magic.

highlights.name: Parallel Lives
highlights.reason: Doubles all token creation. Every Treasure becomes 2, every Chatterfang Squirrel doubles again. Multiplicative with Academy Manufactor and other token generators for explosive board states.

highlights.name: Skullclamp
highlights.reason: Equip to any 1/1 token (Squirrel, Servo, Construct) — it dies immediately, drawing 2 cards. Repeatable card advantage engine that also triggers sacrifice payoffs.
